title: messaging.py: Receipts list grows unbounded
description: Line 250 appends to `self._receipts` without any size limit. Unlike inbox (capped at _MESSAGES_MAX=100), receipts grow forever. Sustained POST traffic to /msg/ack exhausts memory.
close_reason: Cap /msg/ack receipts at _MESSAGES_MAX=100, dropping oldest; independent test fills past MAX and asserts len == MAX.
